detail.longDescription: Codex does not have permissions for basic tasks anymore Codex does not have permissions for basic tasks anymore codex-app For about a week, codex has refused to run commands for me on the terminal, commit files to git, or shell into prod. All of these worked fine last week - I haven't changed any settings to my knowledge. I'm on the pro plan and on the latest version of the app. Can someone see what's going wrong? Asking Astra really seems to confuse it. I am using a work mode session, it doesn’t make any difference if i run full access mode or not, it never has permissions. Codex can edit code normally, but it seems that's all it can do.
